text:
Fukuoka ramen has seven noodle levels.
Most first-timers just say "normal" 👇

🍜 Hardest to softest
Nama · Harigane · Barikata · Kata
Futsu · Yawa · Bariyawa

Locals tend to go a little firm.
The thin noodles soften fast.

🔁 The refill
Keep the soup, order kaedama:
a second serving of noodles.

💡 The tip
Order the refill one step softer.
The soup has cooled by then.

🌅 Ganso Nagahamaya opens at 6:00.
